newsitem.title: USA: Amerada Hess extends Transocean rig lease.
newsitem.headline: Amerada Hess extends Transocean rig lease.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said on Wednesday Amerada Hess Ltd U.K. would extend its charter of Transocean's fourth-generation semisubmersible Transocean No 8 for five months.
The company said in a statement Amerada Hess confirmed the extension of the long-term charter with Transocean's Norwegian subsidiary Transocean ASA.

The five-month contract extension eliminates an open interval in the rig's schedule that existed from about Nov 1, 1996 to April 1, 1997. Revenues generated from the five-month extension are estimated at $17 million.
Amerada Hess had agreed to contract the Transocean No 8 for a firm period of two years, commencing about May 1, 1997, with three one-year options to follow.
Under the agreement with Amerada Hess, the rig will undergo an upgrade which will result in an increase of its water depth rating to 4,500 feet. Estimated cost of the upgrade is $47.5 million.
Amerada Hess has reserved the right to sublet the rig to other North Sea operators as scheduling permits.
